name: Ratmen Clans
background:
Ratmen Clans are humanoid rats, originally created as an accidental byproduct of advanced genetic science. Lacking the organization and skill of other factions, Ratmen clans use their vast numbers and a variety of weapons to defeat their foes. 

As Ratmen emerged to their creators as sentient beings, they were greeted with fear and violence, and they were forced into a life of hiding and scavenging until they could flee their home world. Now that they finally found safety on secluded and abandoned worlds, where their numbers rapidly grew, they seek to help others even as many in Sirius still view them as vermin.
backgroundFull:
Soon after their arrival in Sirius, the Conduit’s followers turned to genetic experimentation to adapt to the challenges of their new reality. Their scientists began testing on the rodents who had stowed away in their fleet, but they had to make due with their rather limited number of test subjects, reusing them multiple times over a number of tests.

These test subjects began to grow, developing increased reaction time and strength compared to typical rats. Some scientists began to report signs of collaboration, tool use, and even communication among the rodents. Rumours began to spread about subjects escaping the laboratories. These reports were ignored and dismissed by superiors who were desperate for further advances to be made to the Battle Brother gene-mods.

Feral colonies of rats began to form outside of the labs, where the descendants of the original test subjects continued to grow in size and intelligence. The resulting species had become fully sapient and gradually emerged to greet their creators as equals. The humans who created them, however, viewed them with horror and revulsion, and the Ratmen were driven into hiding as Humanity hunted them as vermin and failed test subjects.

The Ratmen soon decided to flee off world rather than risk destruction if they were discovered. They began to raid less defended ships and scrap heaps in order to slowly assemble a fleet. Yet before they left, the Ratmen agreed that they could not escape and leave the other rats to their fate. Together, the Ratmen launched a raid on the laboratories where they were created, and despite heavy casualties, they escaped with the surviving test subjects.

The fleeing Ratmen fleet found a remote and uninhabited system, where they could build a new home for themselves. Some decided to stay there and remain hidden from the Battle Brothers and those like them. Others decided that they no longer wished to hide from the galaxy. Instead, these Ratmen formed into family-run clans on their ships and began to explore the stars.

As the Ratman clans encountered other factions, they began to recognize their own former plight in those oppressed or imprisoned by other factions. The Clans use their skills to help others escape, or otherwise sabotage those they view as oppressors, and some factions have come to view them as foes and vermin, to be actively sought out for destruction.

How will you survive in a sector that views you as vermin?

product.description:
Leading a band of vigilante Ratmen operating in the heart of Tugator, Quiprie seeks to maintain order on the station and keep her people safe. Distrustful of ambitious adventurers out to make a quick credit and anyone who might bring trouble to her station, players soon find themselves on the long end of her dual pistols.

As shady operators clash over control of the relics, players will have to earn the trust of this sceptical Clan Handler if they hope to find a reliable ally on Tugator; until then, she will serve as a dogged and clever adversary.

specialRules.name: Scurry
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Reinforcement
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: This hero may only be taken once per party.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

specialRules.name: Predator Shooter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when shooting, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Evasive Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Evasive. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Scurry
specialRules.description: If this model has Scurry, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Scurry (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Defense Debuff
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Spawn
specialRules.description: Add a friendly AI unit of X to the party, which is deployed as if it were a hero. This unit is activated after all Heroes, and follows the AI activation rules.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Takedown Shot
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Anti-Regen
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Precision Shooter
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

specialRules.name: Hazardous
specialRules.description: Gets AP(4), but on unmodified results of 1 to hit this model takes one wound, or X wounds if this weapon has the Blast(X)/Deadly(X) rule.

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Agile
specialRules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Evasive
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as enemy models in the target unit and within 3” of it. Hits must be split evenly between all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (players pick how).

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
